header: Identity and Access Management in Amazon OpenSearch Service
content:
Service
Amazon OpenSearch Service oﬀers several ways to control access to your domains. This topic
covers the various policy types, how they interact with each other, and how to create your own
custom policies.
Important
VPC support introduces some additional considerations to OpenSearch Service access
control. For more information, see the section called “About access policies on VPC
domains”.
